description.en: Original F.misrai-inspired fossil-form SPECIMEN study, not whole living-organism reconstruction or exact specimen replica. Long spindle shape and opposed hierarchical modules informed by actual2024 Figure2 fossils, especially D and E, distinct from the article Figure3 interpretive CFD mesh. Relief, matrix outline, coloration and nominal300mm footprint artistic. Biological affinity/feeding and complete three-dimensional living anatomy uncertain. No behaviour/CFD claim, no ovoid F.andersoni features.
